title: The seven-piece Savoy group
summary: He lists the seven-piece group, with organ, Rupert Cole and Les Jenkins, and tries to remember the tenor player.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who were those seven pieces?
Oh, I had an organ, a rhythm section, myself --
You didn't have Kenny Kersey, did you?
No.
You had him earlier, though, didn't you?
Yeah.
We'll go back to that in a minute.
And -- who did I have on tenor? The tenor player -- and Rupert Cole, alto.
Oh, really?
Uh-huh. We had a trombone player.
Could Rupert Cole -- did he solo?
Not particularly, no.
No. But you needed him there for your arrangements and things.
Yeah.
Yeah. Who did you say you had on tenor?
I'm trying to think. Can't think of the tenor player.
It wasn't Lockjaw?
No, no. It wasn't Lockjaw then.
Well, we'll go back to that. Or we'll ask
Stan if we have to.
Yeah.
Well --
George Clark.
Oh. Oh, I see. Who was your drummer?
Who was my drummer then? Les Jenkins.
Oh. I see. But that lasted about seven years.
Yeah. I stayed there.
We'll retrace our steps for dates, because what we didn't go into yet, which we should, is like, you know, when you got Cleanhead, and so on.
Yeah.
